# Lab 19.3: Automated Metadata Generation

## What We Are Going to Do
Let Gemini write table and column descriptions, review them, and publish them to the catalog.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Generate descriptions.** Open `lab19.orders → Schema`. Click **Generate** (or **Gemini → Generate descriptions**). Gemini suggests a table description and a description for each column.

2. **[Console] Review.** Read every suggestion. Edit anything wrong, for example change *"num_of_item: number of items"* to *"Number of items in the order (1–4)"*. Then click **Save to schema** / **Publish**.

3. **[CLI] Confirm the descriptions are stored.**

4. **[Console] Run it at scale.** In **Metadata curation → Metadata generation**, start a job for all of `lab19`. Review results in bulk before publishing.

5. **Discuss.** AI descriptions save time, but a data owner must review them, because agents and analysts will trust them.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Generated | Table and column descriptions |
| Review | Edited by a human before publishing |
| Storage | In the BigQuery schema and the catalog |
| Benefit | Better search and better AI agent answers |
